title: Spike: what Octave's players need for a stream that steps, a quick language switch, and a one-playback link
description: Serves "The picture follows the connection."; "Their languages come first.". Media3 now; AVPlayer's half when Octave builds its Apple app's playback (ASK-7). No product change.
